title: atem-agentic-os
text:
Tested codex/local-handoff. The directory is working and ready to merge.
Static server: passed
HTML and hero asset: HTTP 200
Search/state filters and empty state: passed
City filtering logic: passed
Claim form and browser storage: passed
Desktop layout: three columns, no overflow
Mobile layout: one column, no overflow
All eight provider links: HTTP 200
Secret/debug scan: clean
Repository remained unchanged

There is no build, lint, or unit-test command because the project is intentionally buildless. The documented limitations—browser-only form storage and no payment/backend—remain accurate.
